transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Hi, thank you. Um, well, I’m here because flying has just started to feel way scarier than it really should. Just... just the idea of getting on a plane makes me picture that awful turbulence from my honeymoon flight all over again. I mean, logically I know people fly safely every single day, but I just can't seem to shake it.
Is this fear limited to flying, or do you experience similar anxiety in other situations, like social settings, public places, or when separated from loved ones?

No, it's really just the flying. I mean, I'm fine in crowds or talking to people, and I don't get nervous being away from my husband or anything like that. It's just... planes. That's the only thing that gets to me.
Have you been avoiding flying or making any changes to your life because of this fear, like turning down trips or feeling really stressed when you have to travel?

Yeah, I definitely have. Um, I've been choosing to take long drives instead of flying whenever I can, or I'll just turn down work trainings if they require a flight. It's just easier to avoid it. And even if I absolutely have to just talk about an upcoming trip, I really need my husband sitting right there with me to get through it without backing out completely.
How long have you felt this way about flying, and does the fear feel excessive or unreasonable to you even when you're not thinking about an upcoming trip?

Well, this has been going on since that turbulent flight back from my honeymoon. So, that was about two years and five months ago. And yeah, it definitely feels excessive to me. Even when I don't have a trip coming up and I'm just sitting at home, I know my reaction is unreasonable. Like I said, I know flying is safe, so it's just really frustrating to feel this scared of it when I know I shouldn't be.

Have you ever experienced sudden episodes of intense fear or physical symptoms like rapid heartbeat, shortness of breath, or dizziness while not flying, such as when you're at home or in other situations?
No, I haven't really had anything like that. I don't get those sudden panic feelings or a racing heart when I'm just at home or doing regular things. It really only happens when it comes to flying.
Do you ever feel anxious or have physical symptoms like a racing heart or sweating just thinking or talking about flying, even if you’re not at the airport or on a plane?

Yeah, definitely. Um, if I’m just looking at flights for a work conference, or even if I just hear a plane overhead, my chest tightens up right away. I get this rush of panic, and I feel like I just need to shut my laptop or completely get away from the thought of it.
